chunks: O children of Israel, remember the favours I bestowed on you. So keep your pledge to Me, and I will be faithful to you, and be fearful of Me.
ai.seo_question: What is the covenant between God and the Children of Israel mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as establishing the principle of reciprocal covenant (‘ahd), where human fulfillment of divine obligations invites God’s continued grace and protection. The command to 'fear Me alone' underscores the concept of tawhid in worship, distinguishing between reverence for God’s majesty and avoiding shirk. This reciprocal dynamic is central to understanding the relationship between the Imams and the community, as they embody the perfect fulfillment of the covenant.
